automodDescription: Manage the auto-moderation rules of this server
listDescription: List the auto-moderation rules of this server
addDescription: Add an entry to the list of a rule: a word, an allowed link or an allowed invite
removeDescription: Remove an entry from the list of a rule
ignoreDescription: Exempt a role or a channel from a rule, or stop exempting it
optionsNameDescription: The name of the rule, unique in this server
optionsNewNameDescription: The new name of the rule
optionsTypeDescription: What the rule looks for in the messages
optionsActionAlertDescription: Toggle message alerts in the channel
optionsActionLogDescription: Toggle message logs in the moderation logs channel, if set
optionsPunishmentDescription: Set the moderation action to take after the threshold is reached
optionsPunishmentDurationDescription: Set the duration for the punishment
optionsThresholdDescription: Set the amount of infractions allowed within the set period
optionsThresholdPeriodDescription: Set the time in which infractions will accumulate
optionsMinimumDescription: Capitals: the shortest message the rule looks at, in characters
optionsMaximumDescription: Capitals: percentage of capitals. New lines: lines. Zalgo text: marks on one character
optionsMentionsDescription: Mention spam: the points of mentions allowed within the period
optionsPeriodDescription: Mention spam: the seconds in which the mentions are counted
optionsWarnDescription: Mention spam: warn the member who is about to be banned
optionsValueDescription: A word, the hostname of a link, an invite code or the ID of a server
optionsRoleDescription: The role to exempt, or to stop exempting
optionsChannelDescription: The channel to exempt, or to stop exempting
typeAttachmentsDescription: Detects the messages that have an attachment.
typeCapitalsDescription: Detects the messages of at least {{minimum, number}} characters of which {{maximum, number}}% or more are capitals.
typeInvitesDescription: Detects the invites to other servers.
typeLinksDescription: Detects the messages that contain a link.
typeNewlinesDescription: Detects the messages of more than {{maximum, number}} lines.
typeNoMentionSpamDescription: Bans the members who go over {{mentionsAllowed, number}} points of mentions within {{timePeriod, number}} seconds.
typePhishingDescription: Detects the links to the websites that are known to steal accounts.
typeWordsDescription: Detects the messages that contain a filtered word.
typeZalgoDescription: Detects the messages in which a character carries more than {{maximum, number}} combining marks.
createSuccess: Created the rule **{{name}}** ({{type}}). It is enabled and only counts the infractions for now: set what it does with {{command}}.
editNothing: Nothing to change: give at least one option besides the rule.
errorLimit: This server already has {{maximum, number}} rules, which is the most it can have. Delete one first.
errorNameTaken: There is already a rule with that name in this server.
errorNameInvalid: The name of a rule is 1 to {{maximum, number}} characters long, and cannot be made of digits only.
errorUnknown: I could not find a rule named `{{rule}}` in this server.
errorOptionNotSupported: **{{name}}** is a {{type}} rule, which has no `{{option}}` option.
errorOptionRange: `{{option}}` must be between {{minimum, number}} and {{maximum, number}}.
errorNoList: **{{name}}** is a {{type}} rule, which has no list to add to or remove from.
errorListFull: The list of **{{name}}** already has {{maximum, number}} entries, which is the most it can have.
errorWordLength: A word is {{minimum, number}} to {{maximum, number}} characters long.
addExists: `{{value}}` was already in the list of **{{name}}**.
removeMissing: `{{value}}` was not in the list of **{{name}}**.
ignoreNothing: Give a role, a channel, or both.
listEmpty: This server has no auto-moderation rule. Create one with {{command}}.
